senses.gloss:
Edidhiṣuḥ-pati is a term occurring only in the Vājasaneyi
Saṃhitā,^1 where the commentator Mahīdhara interprets it as
[]
meaning the ‘husband of a younger sister married before the
elder sister.’ Though this sense is probably correct, the form
is doubtless, as Delbrück^2 points out, corrupt. See Didhiṣūpati.
1) xxx. 9.
2) Die indogermanischen Verwandschaftsnamen, 569. n. 1.
